ablation.name: brk_z_ll_wct
ablation.notes: LL WCT (full 4x4 covariance matching) replaces AdaIN (diagonal-only). Math: DINOv2 CLS token is sensitive to channel correlations (off-diagonal covariance). AdaIN transfers only mean+std (diagonal), missing channel correlation structure. WCT whitens content covariance and colors with style covariance, transferring full channel correlation. brk_w (HF WCT) failed because HF subbands have important spatial structure that WCT disrupts; LL subband is spatially smooth so WCT should be safer. Target: DINO-S>0.485 via better channel correlation transfer.
